# GitHub REST

`github-com-3aeb002460` · openapi · version `1.1.4` · **published** · readiness `reviewed_publication_user_test_required`

Connect GitHub's REST API (api.github.com) with a personal access token. Lists your repositories and reads files at a ref for Ragentic's Repository manifests. Independent connector for GitHub. Not affiliated with or endorsed by GitHub.
